details: The package is a trojanized clone of the verdaccio-okta-oauth plugin. On npm install, the preinstall hook (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime binary from github[.]com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ (selecting the correct binary for the platform/architecture), extracts it, and executes a 727KB heavily-obfuscated file (math_init.js) through it. The obfuscated payload uses eval, Function constructor, and child_process calls. The legitimate plugin source code is included as cover but the install-time execution of the downloaded runtime and obfuscated payload is the attack vector.
